name: Rudy Lineback
original_name: ロディ・ラインバック
source:
Disowned by his own father and forced to make his way in life, Rudy is on a quest to become a Hunter. He often acts without deep consideration of his actions.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P011]J-List[/url]]
